{{Quote|I am Lieutenant Dorss, customs. This is Sergeant Vult. He will conduct a brief inspection of your craft. Are all compartments accessible?''"<br />"''They are.|Lieutenant Dorss and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="OC" />}}
'''Vult''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Customs official/Legends|customs officer]] stationed in [[43 ABY]] at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dor'shan/Legends|Dor'shan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], where he served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. The Kel Dor officer inspected the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of the recently [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], when they landed on Dorin to find out more about [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Sergeant Vult found that all items on board the vessel were permissible, which allowed the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalkers]] to visit Dorin.

==Biography==
Vult was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who lived on the<ref name="OC" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]<ref name="OC" /> in [[43 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Vult served as a [[Customs official/Legends|customs officer]] for the government of Dorin and held the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] during that [[Time/Legends|time]]. In 43 ABY, the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], visited Dorin and landed in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Dor'shan/Legends|Dor'shan]], in their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]''.<ref name="OC" />

While Vult inspected the ship, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Dorss]] asked the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalkers]] for the purpose of their visit. Luke Skywalker told the Lieutenant that he intended to speak with the [[Baran Do]], in hopes of finding out more about [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and transformation into [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Caedus. After Vult had completed the inspection of the ''Shadow'', he reported to Dorss that all items on the ship corresponded with the categorical limits. The Lieutenant then allowed the Skywalkers to visit the Baran Do.<ref name="OC" />

==Personality and traits==
Vult served as a customs officer with Lieutenant Dorss; he inspected vessels that landed at the spaceport in Dor'shan. To do so, he used a baton-like instrument, connected via cable to a backpack that he wore, that possessed several [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] intakes along its length. The Kel Dor was thin, had no [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and had [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that were intelligent and [[Human/Legends|Human]]-like in appearance.<ref name="OC" />

==Equipment==
He wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Robe/Legends|robe]] with sky-blue and black patterns on it as well as a [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|breath mask]]<ref name="OC" /> to protect him from [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]], [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]], and [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], which were fatal to a Kel Dor.<ref name="UAT">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Vult was able to [[Language/Legends|speak]] his native [[Kel Dor (language)/Legends|Kel Dor]].<ref name="OC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vult made his only appearance briefly as a minor character in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]]. ''Outcast'' is the first book of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="OC" />
